title: "..."
category: llm-agent-behaviour     # exactly one slug from taxonomy.yml
labels: [AI Agents, Benchmarks]   # one or more, all must exist in taxonomy.yml
image: images/....jpg             # optional — omit entirely for a no-image card
thumbnail: images/thumbs/....jpg   # generated by scripts/generate_thumbnails.py

date: YYYY-MM

#     url: https://...
#   - label: "model"
#     url: https://...
venue: "arXiv"                    # or journal name
description: "One sentence, plain language, for the grid card."
# order: 1                        # optional, ascending; omit for default alphabetical-by-filename position within the category
---

Not rendered anywhere (project pages aren't built — see _quarto.yml's
`!projects/**` render exclude and scripts/build_board.py). Card
title/thumbnail link straight to `paper` (or the first entry of `papers`).
Keep write-up notes here only for your own reference if useful.
